## 🐛 Bug Report

### Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

### Expected Behavior
What should happen when the steps are followed.

### Actual Behavior
What actually happens.

### Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

### Environment
- OS: [e.g. macOS, Windows, Linux]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Safari, Firefox]
- Node.js version: [e.g. 18.0.0]
- npm version: [e.g. 9.0.0]

### Additional Context
- Related PRD section: [e.g. Section 8.3 - Time representation]
- Related use case: [e.g. UC-009 - Create customer booking]
- Business ID (if applicable):
- Booking ID (if applicable):

### Severity
- [ ] Critical (system down, data loss)
- [ ] High (major functionality broken)
- [ ] Medium (minor functionality broken)
- [ ] Low (cosmetic issue)

### Reproduction Frequency
- [ ] Always
- [ ] Sometimes
- [ ] Rarely
- [ ] Unable to reproduce

**Note:** For security vulnerabilities, please do not open a public issue. Contact the maintainers directly.
